fields.shortNameHint: Used in generated numbers, e.g. admission numbers ({SCHOOL} token)
fields.auditLogRetentionDaysHint: Audit log entries older than this are pruned nightly. Default 365.
fields.dataExportAvailabilityDaysHint: How long a generated export ZIP stays downloadable before it's deleted. Default 7.
fields.autoAnonymizeInactiveDaysHint: Leave blank to disable (default). If set, accounts with no login for this many days are automatically anonymized.
